audience: staffing agencies that bill clients and pay contractors with Bilflo

useCases.title: List our clients and their contacts
useCases.text: Lists clients with business name, client code and active flag, opens one client with its addresses and contacts, and lists a client's contacts.

useCases.title: Show a contract job with its pay and bill rates
useCases.text: Reads a contract job with client, contractor, dates and status, its pay and bill items such as Regular and Overtime, and who approves the timecards.

useCases.title: Check a client's billing setup
useCases.text: Lists a client's agreements, contract purchase orders, invoice groups and addresses, so you can see the billing terms in one place.

useCases.title: Run a saved custom report
useCases.text: Runs one of the company's saved custom reports with the parameters you give, such as a start and end date, and returns its rows.

useCases.title: Update, terminate or reopen a contract job
useCases.text: Changes a job's title, overtime rule or flags, ends it on a date, or reopens a terminated job. Overtime rules can be listed first.

useCases.title: Add or update a client
useCases.text: Creates a client with a business name, or changes a client's name, code, phone or active flag.
